cues: Rectified spirit, ninety five point six percent.
Denatured alcohol, made undrinkable with methanol, pyridine and a little copper sulphate, so industry can use it free of drinks tax.
Power alcohol, petrol with twenty to twenty five percent ethanol, which saves imported fuel.
And alcoholic beverages, fermented like beer and chhyang, or distilled like raksi.
text: Five terms you must define. Rectified spirit, ninety five point six percent. Absolute alcohol, a hundred percent. Denatured alcohol, made undrinkable with methanol, pyridine and a little copper sulphate, so industry can use it free of drinks tax. Power alcohol, petrol with twenty to twenty five percent ethanol, which saves imported fuel. And alcoholic beverages, fermented like beer and chhyang, or distilled like raksi.
